comments: Class-weighted (WCE) loss experiment: clean negative, no relaunch planned. Completed all 300 epochs without collapsing, but landed at val dice=0.2520 (epoch 170, genuinely QAT-active) -- barely above the trivial-background floor and far below phase 1's best (val dice 0.5144, kuralsnet_npu_seg.json). Root cause: NBSLoss's plain per-pixel mean (unlike nn.CrossEntropyLoss's weight-sum-renormalized mean) lets extreme class-weight skew (~800,000x background:vehicle) collapse the aggregate gradient magnitude. Class weighting is abandoned for now rather than reimplementing a renormalized reduction; phase 1 (unweighted) remains the final architecture.
